semantic.justification: Represented native RTF import now carries current-model character decoration, links and paragraph indentation; complete upstream responsibilities remain unverified. RTF byte decoding now selects pinned SAL ASCII, ISO-8859 and KOI8 aggregates. UTF-8 code page 65001 now dispatches to the pinned SAL converter with its native malformed-input and BOM defaults. Uses OStringToOUString default flags and FLUSH, retaining private-use undefined-byte mapping and incomplete UTF-8 replacement. Routes RTF code page 932 through the source-owned SAL DBCS converter and tables. Routes RTF code pages 936, 949 and 950 through source-owned SAL DBCS tables and EUDC semantics. Dispatches RTF EUC-JP bytes through the source-owned ImplEUCJPToUnicode path. Dispatches RTF ISCII Devanagari bytes through a fresh source-owned converter context. Dispatches RTF code page 65000 through the pinned SAL UTF-7 converter. Dispatches RTF code pages 50220/50225 through pinned ISO-2022-JP/KR state machines. Uses the pinned SAL dummy converter for missing code pages instead of a browser TextDecoder. S3HW1E named character-style integration: stylesheet cs entries materialize actual SwCharFormat owners separately from paragraph collections, resolve same-family forward parents, and apply represented character properties. Real SwFormatCharFormat/SwTextCharFormat hints retain selected style identity, direct-property precedence and group/plain restoration; the native current character-style index remains distinct from the selected rStyle reference for failed lookups. RTF OutputTextCharFormat emits original cs IDs before repeated effective properties, as the source requires. Character-style positive baseline percentages are kept separate from paragraph automatic superscript. The represented RTFSprms getDefaultSPRM character families reset absent run bold/italic/underline/font/height/color properties present in the flattened style reference; non-defaulted strikeout/highlight/escapement/kerning inherit. Plain clears direct kerning rather than inventing a false direct override. Native style-default helper compiled unchanged with original generated OOXML IDs under ASan/UBSan yields9 defaults among35 queried tokens; scalar/nested value carriers are not full RTFValue/RTFSprms or mapper ABI. Existing run-projection/string-sink bindings remain explicit; complete native property graph, duplicate style-index semantics, linked styles, paragraph-style cs/s cross-family behavior, CJK/CTL import association, script/bidi and remaining whole-filter obligations are unverified. Temporary imported automatic style handles/sets are disposed, and export run item sets now use generator-scoped ownership.
